g.text: VALIDATION — 8 checks, run once at ingest
HEURISTIC REGISTRY — a fixed list, iterated in order
CROSS-SUBMISSION — needs more than one bundle

g.title: index
g.text: ordered access, per-session and per-file views

g.title: contrib
g.text: THREE facts, never collapsed into two.
Grouped on the attributed student_ref only;
an unattributed session is its own singleton,
never pooled and never asserted distinct.
never machine_id, never a git author,

g.title: coverage
g.text: Answers in all three states: not available,
nothing to note, or the facts.

g.title: pol
g.text: read back out of the bundle's own signed manifest —
not out of any server-side setting.
A heuristic that consumes a DISABLED signal returns
not-applicable: never a flag, and never a zero.

g.title: recon
g.text: replay edits; tag each line typed / pasted /

g.title: cand
g.text: one place to teach about a new paste source

g.title: dag
g.text: two claims disagreeing on one sha ⇒
no edge asserted in either direction

g.title: extclass
g.text: Only git_merge_in suppresses, and only on an
exact sha256 match against a state a PROVABLY
DIFFERENT verified contributor recorded on the
same path — never on a clock. Reclassified
events stay in the index and in the verdict map.

g.title: split
g.text: ONE enumeration of overlapping session pairs
and ONE ‘different’ decision, split two ways.
so a suppressed pair is UNREPRESENTABLE in
the heuristic — drift is a compile error.

g.title: witness
g.text: Facts only: no Flag, no check, no score,
and it never names a person.
Nothing in the pipeline calls it yet.

g.title: integ
g.text: lifts each FAILED check into the same flag list

g.title: imove
g.text: is this paste a copy of the student's OWN
earlier content, whose provenance is typed?

g.title: sort
g.text: then supporting seq ↑ — a stable tie-break that

g.title: down
g.text: scores 0 under default weights, so it leaves the
ranked queue — but is NEVER suppressed. The record
and its jump-to-source link both remain.
no — or the source region itself
